ModMetaData.name: RimTalk - Stagecraft
ModMetaData.author: pyaoyao
ModMetaData.description:
RimTalk 的附属模组：让小人知道自己在哪、手上的事是冲着谁去的，让持续几天的状况和刚接下的任务被聊起来，另外能用导演指示安排一场聊天。
· 所在地：告诉模型这是什么地方，也可以自己写 · 行动对象标出身份：（殖民者）（囚犯）（动物） · 持续状况补聊、接任务就聊 · 导演指示 //……// 和“让其开口”按钮 · （联动）文学扩展的世界说明
每项都能在设置里单独开关，不改写存档。需要 Harmony 和 RimTalk，支持 1.6 和 1.7。
An add-on for RimTalk: pawns know where they are and who their job is aimed at, lasting conditions and new quests get talked about, and director's notes set up a conversation.
- Location: tells the model what this place is; you can write your own - Job targets tagged: (colonist), (prisoner), (animal) - Lasting conditions and accepted quests talked about - Director's notes //...// and a "Make speak" button - (Integration) world description for RimTalk - Expand Literature
Each part can be switched off in the settings. Does not alter saves. Requires Harmony and RimTalk; 1.6 and 1.7.
